assets.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: transparent decorative mascot for SchedSnap responsive website
Primary request: one extremely cute coral pink axolotl mascot, cheerful smile, plump rounded pear-shaped body, tiny short arms and feet, three soft berry pink external gills on each side of its head, little tail visible at one side. Tiny dark round eyes and tiny curved smile, subtle peach blush.
Style/medium: polished soft matte 3D clay/plush character, smooth rounded heavy forms, minimal details, soft studio highlights.
Composition/framing: full body centered, front view with slight three-quarter depth, square image with generous transparent margins, one character only.
Scene/backdrop: genuinely transparent alpha background, isolated cutout.
Constraints: no outlines, no text, no logos, no watermark, no ground plane, no pedestal, no background, no cast shadow outside the body. Preserve clean transparent edges.

validation.visual: Full body coral axolotl with berry gills and transparent cutout; smile and feet clearly visible.
